title: Prove analytic E8 binary-support capacities 12 and 20
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp binary-support capacities 12 and 20 for ranks at most five and six on the declared full E8 labels and fixed P112. This replaces the global flat-census upper-bound dependency used in PR3249, PR3255 and PR3260 with an analytic signed character-sum argument.

```text
Leading-one labels of rank at most d lie in an affine (d-1)-space.
The E8 quadratic form has positive Gauss sum 16.
Its signed radical cases exclude the apparent 16/24-point maxima.
The resulting bounds are 12/20, with actual P112 witnesses.
```

Only `research/e8-quadratic-support-capacity/` is added. The exact model binding checks all 120 root residues and 112 existing live labels. No new shortening threshold or historical caller exclusion is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before, these global upper bounds were supplied by 3,309,747 five-flat and 788,035 six-flat censuses. After, PROOF.md gives the affine character-sum proof. The finite replay binds its model and sign; it does not rerun those censuses.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes both implementations and seven optimized behavioral groups. Opposite-sign controls attain 16/24 and expose the necessary hypothesis. A designated read-only peer check found no blocker at this scope; its exact eleven-file receipt is retained in REVIEW.json.
- All thirteen committed package/input byte comparisons and the committed exporter integrity check pass. All three direct commands also pass under optimized CPython 3.13.16 in the exact committed read-only Git-free export. Ruff, formatting, source compilation and metadata/source pins pass.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B   scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-quadratic-support-capacity
```

Canonical main was refreshed unchanged at `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Submission overlap through 2026-10-17T20:05:51Z covers 313 open PRs and 2,102 Discussion records with complete pagination. Closed, arbitrary-diff and unpublished work are not exhaustive. Earlier duplicate candidate scopes were released; this contribution contains only the distinct analytic-capacity obligation.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003593). Credit Nick Petalas's PR3249/3255/3260 and root-simplex sources, David Arias's retained masked-root-star-assembly quadratic model, and the E8/P112 lineage including joaqcoo. There are no pending executable or Git-object dependencies. Open next questions and precise source pins are included.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One proof/replay package. Its theorem replaces precisely the support-capacity upper bounds. Weyl/A2/lifting, shortening/caller and full decoder/supplier obligations remain separate. No native realization, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed. Formal-kernel and independent human review, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun.
